title: Application run visibility
summary: Observe stage/request start/end, retry/timeout/failure, saved intermediate results, latency and cost. This application layer is distinct from coding-session observations.
body: Planned boundary: receives Application runtime stage/request events; produces Local application trace and readable report. Owns Visibility into each application run. Must preserve: Remain separate from coding-agent hook events and do not claim unobserved causes. Inspect actual code before claiming this boundary is already enforced.
